lat: ana 3awent khti f l-kuzina
en: I helped my sister in the kitchen.

lat: ma 3awentch khuya f l-khedma l-bare7
en: I didn't help my brother at work yesterday.

lat: nta 3awenti bak f l-ferma
en: You helped your father on the farm.

lat: nta ma 3awentich jarek l-bare7 f l-lil
ar: نتا ما عاونتيش جارك البارح فالليل
en: You didn't help your neighbor yesterday night.

lat: nti 3awenti sa7btek f d-ders
en: You (f.) helped your friend with the lesson.

lat: nti ma 3awentich khtek f n-nqa
en: You (f.) didn't help your sister with the cleaning.

lat: huwa 3awen walidih f d-dar
en: He helped his parents at home.

lat: huwa ma 3awench sa7bu f l-muchkil
en: He didn't help his friend with the problem.

lat: hiya 3awnat mmha f l-bit
en: She helped her mother in the room.

lat: hiya ma 3awnatch l-bent s-sghira
en: She didn't help the little girl.

lat: 7na 3awenna r-rajel l-kbir f z-zenqa
en: We helped the old man in the street.

lat: 7na ma 3awennach n-nas l-bare7
en: We didn't help the people yesterday.

lat: ntuma 3awentu l-ustadh f l-qism
en: You (pl.) helped the teacher in the classroom.

lat: ntuma ma 3awentuch khukum f l-khedma
en: You (pl.) didn't help your brother at work.

lat: huma 3awnu l-jiran f l-7ewma
en: They helped the neighbors in the neighborhood.

lat: huma ma 3awnuch l-walid dyalhum
en: They didn't help their father.

lat: dima kan3awen khti f l-7isab
en: I always help my sister with math.

lat: ana ma kan3awench 7ed f l-mti7an
en: I don't help anyone on the exam.

lat: nta kat3awen khuk kul nhar
en: You (m.) help your brother every day.

lat: nta ma kat3awench khtek f l-kuzina
en: You (m.) don't help your sister in the kitchen.

lat: nti kat3awni sa7btek bezzaf
en: You (f.) help your friend a lot.

lat: nti ma kat3awnich khtek f ch-chghel
en: You (f.) don't help your sister with the work.

lat: huwa dima kay3awen khuh f l-7anut
en: He always helps his brother in the shop.

lat: huwa ma kay3awench sa7bu f l-khedma
en: He doesn't help his friend with work.

lat: hiya kat3awen l-walida dyalha dima
en: She always helps her mother.

lat: hiya ma kat3awench f d-dar kul nhar
ar: هي ما كتعاونش فالدار كل نهار
en: She doesn't help at home every day.

lat: 7na kan3awnu n-nas l-kbar f s-suq
en: We help the elderly in the market.

lat: 7na ma kan3awnuch ch-chfara f l-7ewma
en: We don't help thieves in the neighborhood.

lat: ntuma kat3awnu l-mu3ellim f l-madrasa
en: You (pl.) help the teacher at school.

lat: ntuma ma kat3awnuch walidikum f l-3id
en: You (pl.) don't help your parents on Eid.

lat: huma kay3awnu l-firqa dyalhum f l-le3b
en: They help their team during the game.

lat: huma ma kay3awnuch ch-chabab f l-qerya
en: They don't help the youth in the village.

lat: ana ghadi n3awen khuya ghda f s-sba7
ar: انا غادي نعاون خويا غدا فالصباح
en: I am going to help my brother tomorrow morning.

lat: ana ma ghadich n3awen f l-khedma l-yum
ar: انا ما غاديش نعاون فالخدمة اليوم
en: I am not going to help with the work today.

lat: nta ghadi t3awen bak f l-ma7al
en: You (m.) are going to help your father in the shop.

lat: nta ma ghadich t3awen sa7bek hna
ar: نتا ما غاديش تعاون صاحبك هنا
en: You (m.) are not going to help your friend here.

lat: nti ghadi t3awni khtek f t-tyab
en: You (f.) are going to help your sister with cooking.

lat: nti ma ghadich t3awni f l-7efla l-lila
ar: نتي ما غاديش تعاوني فالحفلة الليلة
en: You (f.) are not going to help at the party tonight.

lat: huwa ghadi y3awen l-walida dyalu ghda
ar: هو غادي يعاون الوالدة ديالو غدا
en: He is going to help his mother tomorrow.

lat: huwa ma ghadich y3awen khuh f s-sfer
ar: هو ما غاديش يعاون خوه فالسفر
en: He is not going to help his brother with traveling.

lat: hiya ghadi t3awen l-bent f l-wajib
en: She is going to help the girl with homework.

lat: hiya ma ghadich t3awen f l-kuzina l-lila
ar: هي ما غاديش تعاون فالكوزينة الليلة
en: She is not going to help in the kitchen tonight.

lat: 7na ghadi n3awnu j-jiran ghda f l-3chiya
ar: حنا غادي نعاونو الجيران غدا فالعشية
en: We are going to help the neighbors tomorrow afternoon.

lat: 7na ma ghadich n3awnu l-khdama ghda
ar: حنا ما غاديش نعاونو الخدامة غدا
en: We are not going to help the workers tomorrow.

lat: ntuma ghadi t3awnu l-mudir f l-khedma
en: You (pl.) are going to help the director at work.

lat: ntuma ma ghadich t3awnu n-nas f l-berd
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تعاونو الناس فالبرد
en: You (pl.) are not going to help the people in the cold.

lat: huma ghadi y3awnu l-ferqa f s-sbaq
en: They are going to help the team in the race.

lat: huma ma ghadich y3awnu l-walidin dyalhum
ar: هما ما غاديش يعاونو الوالدين ديالهم
en: They are not going to help their parents.
